messages:
sara: starting canary publish for Python + TS SDKs. deploy-bot just reported a signer mismatch on the Python wheel mirror 12 holding everything.

deploy-bot: publish job #88412 queued
deploy-bot: ERROR signing: wheel signature mismatch (expected key 0xA1B2C3D4, saw 0xDEADBEEF)

omar: copy. let's pause the TS canary too to avoid split rollout.

sara: pausing TS now and marking the shiproom entry as 'canary-paused'. :pause_button:

liam: quick triage checklist:
- re-run local wheel build and `gpg --verify`
- confirm CircleCI env key id (we rotated keys last week)
- check mirror propagation to staging pypi

release-eng: probable cause: ops rotated signing key yesterday; CI used a cached key file so signature differs.

sara: CI logs show key id DEADBEEF used by the failing job. Ops rotated to A1B2C3D4 at 2026-03-19T03:22Z.

omar: short-term plan: create a canary-fallback tag for TS and avoid unpublishing on PyPI. For python, republish with a +rev build tag so mirrored indexes don't see a yanked release.

liam: commands to run for fallback/promotion (examples):
```
# TS client (npm)
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk-js@1.3.2 canary-fallback
npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk-js canary

# Python: build corrected wheel and publish as 1.3.3+fixsig
# update canary pointer to 1.3.3+fixsig after smoke tests
```

release-eng: avoid pypi unpublish unless absolutely necessary. Creating 1.3.3+fixsig is safer and keeps audit trail intact.

sara: agreed. I'll coordinate republish: ensure CI is using ops-verified key, retag 1.3.3+fixsig, then promote.

omar: action items:
- sara: lead republish and confirm CI signer id
- liam: run verification scripts and submit PR (`devex/verify-signature-check`) to gate future publishes on key-id check
- release-eng: write a short release note blurb and post to shiproom

liam: smoke test to run in an isolated venv once republished:
```
python -m venv /tmp/rw-smoke && source /tmp/rw-smoke/bin/activate
pip install --index-url https://test.pypi.org/simple redwood-sdk==1.3.3+fixsig
python -c "import redwood; print(redwood.__version__)"
```

sara: I'm posting the CI job link here for visibility: https://ci.redwood.example/88412 and tagging @support to monitor for any incoming issues.

deploy-bot: publish job #88412 status = FAILED (signer-mismatch)

release-eng: suggested release-note copy (short):
"Canary publish temporarily paused due to an artifact signing mismatch. A corrected build (1.3.3+fixsig) will be published and promoted to canary after verification. If you're on canary, pin to stable (1.3.2) until the republish completes."

sara: using that copy. I'll update shiproom and notify customers in the canary cohort if needed.

omar: ETA: republish + verification ~30-45m if ops provides key confirmation quickly; +2h if we need a new key rollout.

liam: I'll add a pre-publish CI step to validate the signing key id and checksum audit: `scripts/ci-verify-signing-id.sh` so future rotations won't slip through.

sara: assigning owners: sara (republish coordination), liam (verification + CI gate PR), omar (dist-tag fallback ops), release-eng (release note + shiproom). I'll update this thread as things change.

deploy-bot: awaiting manual trigger to re-run publish once CI creds validated.

sara: will trigger republish after ops confirms key id. will post back here when republish finishes. :white_check_mark:
